apps.name: Cheesera
apps.subtitle: Analog film simulation & recipes
apps.localizedDescription: Cheesera is a clean, tactile mobile film simulation app designed for photographers. Features authentic Fujifilm-style recipe simulation, custom 3D .cube LUT importing, disposable camera capture mode, shake-to-develop chemical darkroom timers, external camera/SD-card fast triage, and on-device smart curation.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial release of Cheesera featuring analog film simulation, custom 3D LUT engine, disposable rolls, and shake-to-develop darkroom.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cheesera needs access to your photo library to import photos for film simulation grading.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cheesera needs permission to save graded film photographs to your camera roll.
